title: The Metabolic Rheostat Index Uncovers Pathway-Level Coordination, Immunosuppressive Microenvironment Remodeling, and Therapeutic Co-Vulnerabilities in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma.
snippet: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is characterized by extensive metabolic reprogramming, yet how major metabolic pathways are organized at single-cell resolution, and how this relates to the tumor microenvironment and therapeutic vulnerabilities, remains incompletely understood.
